snp3.1:1.1: Pabbajjaṃ kittayissāmi, yathā pabbaji cakkhumā, yathā vīmaṃsamāno so pabbajjaṃ samarocayi, || ||
snp3.1:2.1: ‘Sambādho 'yaṃ gharāvāso rajassāyatanam' iti ‘abbhokāso ca pabbajjā' iti disvāna pabbaji, || ||
snp3.1:3.1: pabbajitvāna kāyena pāpakammaṃ {vivajjayi} vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā ājīvaṃ parisodhayi. || ||
snp3.1:4.1: Agamā Rājagahaṃ Buddho Magadhānaṃ Giribbajaṃ, piṇḍāya abhihāresi ākiṇṇavaralakkhaṇo. || ||
snp3.1:5.1: Tam addasā Bimbisāro pāsādasmiṃ patiṭṭhito, disvā lakkhaṇasampannaṃ imam atthaṃ abhāsatha: || ||
snp3.1:6.1: "Imaṃ bhonto nisāmetha: abhirūpo brahā suci caraṇena c' eva sampanno, yugamattañ ca pekkhati || ||
snp3.1:7.1: okkhittacakkhu satimā, nāyaṃ nīcakulā-m-iva. Rājadūtā vidhāvantu, kuhiṃ bhikkhu gamissati". || ||
snp3.1:8.1: Te pesitā rājadūtā piṭṭhito anubandhisuṃ: ‘kuhiṃ gamissati bhikkhu, katthavāso bhavissati.' || ||
snp3.1:9.1: Sapadānañ caramāno guttadvāro susaṃvuto khippaṃ pattaṃ apūresi sampajāno patissato. || || Sa
snp3.1:10.1: piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā nikkhamma nagarā muni Paṇḍavaṃ abhihāresi, etthavāso bhavissati. || ||
snp3.1:11.1: Disvāna vāsūpagataṃ tato dūtā upāvisuṃ, eko ca dūto āgantvā rājino paṭivedayi: || ||
snp3.1:12.1: "Esa bhikkhu mahārāja Paṇḍavassa puratthato nisinno vyagghusabho va sīho va girigabbhare". || ||
snp3.1:13.1: Sutvāna dūtavacanaṃ bhaddayānena khattiyo taramānarūpo niyyāsi yena Paṇḍavapabbato. || ||
snp3.1:14.1: Sa yānabhūmiṃ yāyitvā yānā oruyha khattiyo pattiko upasaṃkamma āsajja naṃ upāvisi. || ||
snp3.1:15.1: Nisajja rājā sammodi kathaṃ sārāṇiyaṃ tato, kathaṃ so vītisāretvā imam atthaṃ abhāsatha: || ||
snp3.1:16.1: "Yuvā ca daharo cāsi paṭhamuppattiko susu vaṇṇārohena sampanno jātimā viya khattiyo || ||
snp3.1:17.1: sobhayanto anīkaggaṃ nāgasaṃghapurakkhato, dadāmi bhoge, bhuñjassu, jātiṃ c' akkhāhi pucchito". || ||
snp3.1:18.1: "Ujuṃ janapado rāja Himavantassa passato dhanaviriyena sampanno Kosalesu niketino. || ||
snp3.1:19.1: Ādiccā nāma gottena, Sākiyā nāma jātiyā, tamhā kulā pabbajito 'mhi rāja na kāme abhipatthayaṃ -- || ||
snp3.1:20.1: Kāmesv-ādīnavaṃ disvā nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato padhānāya gamissāmi, ettha me rañjatī mano" ti || || PABBAJJĀSUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
